title: 3 Cheap Coffee Shop Upsells That Add $1,000+/Month
title_options: Easy Coffee Shop Upsells for $1k+ Monthly
Low-Cost Coffee Shop Add-Ons That Earn More
description:
Three tiny, low-cost upsells a coffee shop can add today. Each one uses simple wording, tiny costs, and a real example you can copy.
No fancy tech. No hiring. Just one clear tip, one example with price and script, and how many sales you need to hit $1,000+ a month.

scenes.narration: Pick one simple upsell: a cookie add-on. Sell it at the POS so every coffee becomes a bigger sale.
Example: charge $1.50 for a cookie with coffee. Cookie cost is about $0.25, so profit roughly $1.25 each.
scenes.doodle_prompt: baker placing a tray of cookies, empty price tag

scenes.narration: Train staff to ask: "Would you like a fresh cookie with that? It's $1.50 today." Say it cheerfully, not pushy.
Sell 30 cookies daily at $1.25 margin and you make about $1,125 extra monthly. Follow Blue Ocean Marketing for one marketing fix every day.
scenes.doodle_prompt: customer walking out door with coffee cup, smiling
